comment.text: CBL C384 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Skin tumors; Soft tissue tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: softtissue. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting CBL residue C384 have been observed in skin tumors, CNS tumors, and soft tissue tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
